card.name: Start of words beginning with sub-
card.fires_on: The word piece "sub" (or "Sub", "subs") that begins a longer word, mostly before cutaneous, therapeutic, optimal, acute or sidies.

modes.label: Sub- medical terms
modes.description: "sub" starts a medical word such as subcutaneous, subacute, subtherapeutic or suboptimal.

modes.label: Sub- in general text
modes.description: "Sub" or "subs" starts a non-medical word such as subsidies or samples.

card.plain: It marks the opening piece of words that start with "sub", like subcutaneous or suboptimal.
